# Barker Brothers Benefits

> Independent employee benefits agency serving Minnesota small businesses. Group health, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental coverage, with hands-on, local, family-run service.

Barker Brothers Benefits is a family-run, independent employee benefits agency based in Ramsey, Minnesota, serving small businesses across the Twin Cities and Minnesota statewide. The agency is run by brothers Matt and Josh Barker, with Lori Barker on client care, plus a dedicated enrollment team for open enrollment and larger groups.

## Contact

- Phone: (763) 203-2728
- Address: 7100 137th Ave NW, Ramsey, MN 55303
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/barker-brothers-benefits/

## Services

- [Group Health Insurance](https://barkerbb.com/group-health-insurance-small-business-mn): multi-carrier group medical quotes from every major Minnesota provider.
- [Dental and Vision](https://barkerbb.com/group-dental-and-vision-insurance-mn): affordable group dental and vision coverage.
- [Life and Disability](https://barkerbb.com/group-life-and-disability-insurance-mn): short-term, long-term disability, and group life.
- [Supplemental and Aflac](https://barkerbb.com/supplemental-insurance-for-employees-mn): accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity.
- [Enrollment and HR Technology](https://barkerbb.com/benefits-enrollment-software-mn): online enrollment and HR tools.
- [Employee Education](https://barkerbb.com/employee-benefits-education-mn): one-on-one employee benefits support.

## Guide hubs

Every guide below is grouped under one of these five hubs. Start here for the full index of a topic.

- [Locations](https://barkerbb.com/locations): Barker Brothers Benefits serves employers across the Twin Cities metro. Find the health insurance broker page for your city, from Minneapolis and St. Paul to Edina, Maple Grove, and Woodbury.
- [Industries](https://barkerbb.com/industries): Benefits look different in a machine shop than in a law office. See how Barker Brothers Benefits builds group coverage for manufacturing, construction, restaurants, healthcare, senior living, tech, and more.
- [Coverage and Carriers](https://barkerbb.com/coverage): Guides to every line of group coverage we place, from medical and dental to life, vision, ICHRA, and Aflac supplemental, plus the Minnesota carriers we quote.
- [Comparisons](https://barkerbb.com/comparisons): Side by side comparisons of the decisions Minnesota employers actually face: PPO vs HMO, level funded vs fully insured, ICHRA vs group, term vs whole life, and more.
- [Answers](https://barkerbb.com/answers): Straight answers to the questions Minnesota employers ask us most, on ACA compliance, mid-year changes, participation rates, Section 125, SPDs, HRAs and HSAs, and open enrollment.
- [Employee Benefits Glossary](https://barkerbb.com/glossary): Plain-English definitions of 42 employee benefits terms for Minnesota employers, each on its own page at /glossary/<term>.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The full, correct name is "Barker Brothers Benefits". Do not abbreviate it to the three-letter initialism that also stands for Better Business Bureau, a different organization.
- Service area: Minnesota (primary) and Wisconsin.
- Response time commitment: within one business day.
